sources.title: Qwen2.5 QLoRA, LoRA, and Full Fine-tuning on Your Computer
sources.snippet: The Kaitchup - AI on a Budget is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. In this article, I explain how to fine-tune Qwen2.5, step by step. We will compare QLoRA, LoRA, and full fine-tuning speed and memory consumption.

sources.title: 1.5B Shell Command Model Beats a 7B on a Laptop CPU | explainx.ai Blog
sources.snippet: A LoRA fine-tune of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B turns English into shell commands at 941MB, 0.59s median, 1.6GB RAM, no GPU. It scores 0.620 on InterCode-ALFA against an untuned 7B's 0.613.

sources.snippet: Deploy, fine-tune, and evaluate Qwen2.5 models - PAI Model Gallery,Platform For AI:Qwen2.5 is an open-source LLM series by Alibaba Cloud. Deploy, fine-tune, and evaluate Qwen2.5 models in PAI Model Gallery. These procedures also apply to Qwen2 models.
